title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12293)
clause_1_scope: 1. Scope — This standard specifies the recorded characteristic of magnetic audio records on 8-mm Type S motion-picture prints and on fuli-coat motion-picture magnetic film running at the nominal speed of 24 frames [ 102 mm (40) ] per second or 25 frames [ 106 mm ( 42 in ) ] per second.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
